alt: Line chart of public elementary and secondary school enrollment in millions from fall 2010 to fall 2021 for the total, prekindergarten through grade 8, and grades 9 through 12.
chartSummary: Total and prekindergarten through grade 8 enrollment held near 50 and 35 million through 2019, then dropped in 2020 and stayed lower in 2021, while grades 9 through 12 rose slowly to about 15.4 million.
